changeSet.author: mateusz.mucha
changeSet.createView: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name, p.is_deleted AS is_product_deleted, p.created_at AS product_created_at, p.last_modified_at AS product_last_modified_at, p.details AS product_details, pp.id AS price_id, pp.value AS price_value, pp.currency AS price_currency, pp.is_original AS is_price_original, pp.date AS price_date, pp.created_at AS price_created_at, pp.last_modified_at AS price_last_modified_at FROM emp_product p LEFT JOIN emp_product_price pp ON pp.product_id = p.id;
